dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、お、お帰り……なさい……」

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「や、ただいまっと」
dialogues.en: "Did I...... do okay......?"
dialogues.text: "Did I...... do okay......?"

dialogues.jp:
靴を脱ごうとしたところで、俺の顔にじっと視
線が注がれている事に気がついた。
dialogues.en:
"Oh, the 'Hi, Junichi-san' thing? Yeah, yeah, that was
great."
dialogues.text:
"Oh, the 'Hi, Junichi-san' thing? Yeah, yeah, that was
great."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「い、今ので、その……よろしかったでしょう
　か……？」

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.en: "I'll make you some tea......"
dialogues.text: "I'll make you some tea......"

dialogues.jp: ぱたぱたぱた……。
dialogues.en: Patter-patter-patter...
dialogues.text: Patter-patter-patter...

dialogues.jp: 「う〜ん、いいなあ、こういうのも……」
dialogues.en: "Hmm... I kind of like this......"
dialogues.text: "Hmm... I kind of like this......"

dialogues.jp:
着替えてから居間に下りると、テーブルに急須
と湯飲みが載っていた。
dialogues.en:
After I changed my clothes, I come downstairs and find a
teacup and a teapot on the table.
dialogues.text:
After I changed my clothes, I come downstairs and find a
teacup and a teapot on the table.

dialogues.jp:
椅子に座ると、すっと目の前に湯飲みがやって
来て、こぽこぽとお茶が注がれる。
dialogues.en:
As I sit down on the chair, she quickly comes to move the
teacup in front of me and pour tea into it.
dialogues.text:
As I sit down on the chair, she quickly comes to move the
teacup in front of me and pour tea into it.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「どうぞ……」
dialogues.en: "Here you go......"
dialogues.text: "Here you go......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ありがと」
dialogues.en: "Thank you."
dialogues.text: "Thank you."

dialogues.jp:
何ともかいがいしい。何やら、自分がご主人様
にでもなった気分だ。
dialogues.en:
This feels good, and unusual. I feel like I'm the master of
the house.
dialogues.text:
This feels good, and unusual. I feel like I'm the master of
the house.

dialogues.jp: ──あ、似たようなもんか。
dialogues.en: Well, I am, sort of.
dialogues.text: Well, I am, sort of.

dialogues.jp:
それに思い至ると、むずむずと落ち着かなくなっ
た。
dialogues.en:
When I think about it, I start to feel uncomfortable, like
something's tickling my body.
dialogues.text:
When I think about it, I start to feel uncomfortable, like
something's tickling my body.

dialogues.jp:
まるで、皮膚に入り込んだ小さなトゲを取り出
そうと、悪戦苦闘しているような。
dialogues.en:
It feels like I'm fighting to get rid of prickles stung into
my skin.
dialogues.text:
It feels like I'm fighting to get rid of prickles stung into
my skin.

dialogues.jp: 自分でも良く理解の出来ない心情の変化だった。
dialogues.en: It's difficult even for me to understand how I feel.
dialogues.text: It's difficult even for me to understand how I feel.

dialogues.jp: （何なんだ、急に、俺は……？）
dialogues.en: (What's going on with me......?)
dialogues.text: (What's going on with me......?)

dialogues.jp: いらいらとお茶をすする。
dialogues.en: I sip the tea, feeling a little bit frustrated.
dialogues.text: I sip the tea, feeling a little bit frustrated.

dialogues.jp: （あ、美味いな……）
dialogues.en: (Oh, this tastes good......)
dialogues.text: (Oh, this tastes good......)

dialogues.jp:
味も温度も申し分なくて、身も心もほっこりと
落ち着いていった。
dialogues.en:
The taste and the temperature of the tea are perfect, and it
really helps me relax.
dialogues.text:
The taste and the temperature of the tea are perfect, and it
really helps me relax.

dialogues.jp:
身体の中に湧き出てきた何かを、吐息と共に吐
き出した。
dialogues.en:
The indescribable feeling I has is blown out with the deep
exhale.
dialogues.text:
The indescribable feeling I has is blown out with the deep
exhale.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.en: "Yes?"
dialogues.text: "Yes?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「そ、そのですね……私……」

俺の目を避けるように、じっと湯飲みに視線を
注いでいる。お茶が溢れないかと心配だったり。
dialogues.en:
Avoiding eye contact with me, she keeps staring at my
teacup. I begin to worry...
dialogues.text:
Avoiding eye contact with me, she keeps staring at my
teacup. I begin to worry...

dialogues.jp:
これまでのつき合いから、この｛ま／間｝は、何かお願
いをしようとしているのだなと察した。
dialogues.en:
Because I know this thing she always does of holding the
moment. It's easy to guess that she has a favor to ask me.
dialogues.text:
Because I know this thing she always does of holding the
moment. It's easy to guess that she has a favor to ask me.

dialogues.jp: 湯飲みに口をつけ、果たして頼子さんは言った。
dialogues.en: I bring my teacup to my mouth. And Yoriko-san says...
dialogues.text: I bring my teacup to my mouth. And Yoriko-san says...

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「……料理……作りたいと思うのですが……」
dialogues.en: "......I would like to...... cook......"
dialogues.text: "......I would like to...... cook......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.en: "Ug."
dialogues.text: "Ug."

dialogues.jp: げ。
dialogues.en: Shit.
dialogues.text: Shit.

dialogues.jp: ……危ない危ない。半分のところで飲み下した。
dialogues.en: ...That was close. I almost squirted tea out of my nose.
dialogues.text: ...That was close. I almost squirted tea out of my nose.

dialogues.jp: 「あ、いや、でも、まだ早いんじゃないかな？」
dialogues.en: "Ah, well... I think you need more time."
dialogues.text: "Ah, well... I think you need more time."

dialogues.jp:
何せ、昨日の今日である。そうそう、すぐに出
来るようになるとは思えないが……。
dialogues.en:
It was yesterday that she read cookery books for the first
time. I don't think she's ready to be able to cook......
dialogues.text:
It was yesterday that she read cookery books for the first
time. I don't think she's ready to be able to cook......

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「で、ですけど……その……」

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「本を読んでいるばかりで……出来るようにな
　るのでしょうか……？」
dialogues.en: "How can I learn to cook when I'm only reading a book?"
dialogues.text: "How can I learn to cook when I'm only reading a book?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「う〜ん、まあ、ねえ……」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, you have a point......"
dialogues.text: "Yeah, you have a point......"

dialogues.jp:
たしかに、実技も必要だろう。正論ではある。
しかし、実技を支えるのは、確かな知識である
のも正論な訳で……。
dialogues.en:
I believe learning by doing it is necessary. She's right
about that. But it's also true that having the basic
knowledge first is crucial for learning by doing.
dialogues.text:
I believe learning by doing it is necessary. She's right
about that. But it's also true that having the basic
knowledge first is crucial for learning by doing.

dialogues.jp:
「えとさ、あれに載っている事は、一通り覚え
　たのかな？」
dialogues.en: "So, you read through the books and learned the basics?"
dialogues.text: "So, you read through the books and learned the basics?"

dialogues.jp:
千切りとみじん切りの｛い／井｝の中から飛び出せたの
かどうか、それが気になる。大海は広いんだぞ、
と。
dialogues.en:
Did she pass the stage of learning 'cutting into strips' and
'mince'? She needs to know that cooking isn't just about
those.
dialogues.text:
Did she pass the stage of learning 'cutting into strips' and
'mince'? She needs to know that cooking isn't just about
those.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、はい……だいたいは……」

冷めてしまったお茶をぐいっと飲み下す。まあ、
頼子さんがそう言うならそうなんだろう。
dialogues.en:
My tea's already getting cold, but I drink it up. Well, if
she says so, I have to believe her.
dialogues.text:
My tea's already getting cold, but I drink it up. Well, if
she says so, I have to believe her.

dialogues.jp: 「分かった。じゃあ、やってみなよ」
dialogues.en: "Okay. Then you should try."
dialogues.text: "Okay. Then you should try."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、で、でも……その……」

風呂場に持ち込まれた眼鏡のように、笑顔が一
瞬で曇る。
dialogues.en:
Just like a pair of glasses brought into a sauna room, her
smile fogs right up.
dialogues.text:
Just like a pair of glasses brought into a sauna room, her
smile fogs right up.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「食材は……その……えと……」
dialogues.en: "I need...... the ingredients...... to cook......"
dialogues.text: "I need...... the ingredients...... to cook......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「ああ、分かってるって。俺が買ってくるよ。
　で、何を作るつもりなのかな？」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah, I know. I'll go get them for you. What are you going
to make?"
dialogues.text:
"Yeah, I know. I'll go get them for you. What are you going
to make?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、はい、それはですね……」
dialogues.en: "Ah, yes. I am going to make......"
dialogues.text: "Ah, yes. I am going to make......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「カレー、か」
dialogues.en: "Curry and rice, huh?"
dialogues.text: "Curry and rice, huh?"

dialogues.jp:
メモに記されたリストに目を通す。無難なチョ
イスではあるな。
dialogues.en:
I look through the list of groceries. Curry's a very safe
choice, I guess.
dialogues.text:
I look through the list of groceries. Curry's a very safe
choice, I guess.

dialogues.jp:
「まあ、カレーなら食えない物体が出来る事は
　ないだろう」
dialogues.en: "Nobody can mess up with curry."
dialogues.text: "Nobody can mess up with curry."

dialogues.jp: 「でもまあ……冷凍食品も買っておくか」
dialogues.en: "But just in case I should buy some frozen meals, too."
dialogues.text: "But just in case I should buy some frozen meals, too."

dialogues.jp:
それなりに失礼な事を呟きつつ、スーパーを目
指す。
dialogues.en: Murmuring faintly rude things, I go out to a grocery store.
dialogues.text: Murmuring faintly rude things, I go out to a grocery store.

dialogues.jp:
そういや、まともに食材を買うなんてずいぶん
久しぶりのような。もしや、初めて……？
dialogues.en:
It's been a long time since I bought real food. Or maybe
this is the first time......?
dialogues.text:
It's been a long time since I bought real food. Or maybe
this is the first time......?

dialogues.jp: 「……俺の食生活って、何だったんだ……？」
dialogues.en: "......What have I been eating......?"
dialogues.text: "......What have I been eating......?"

dialogues.jp: 「さて、帰るか……」
dialogues.en: "I'm all done......"
dialogues.text: "I'm all done......"

dialogues.jp:
膨らんだビニール袋を手にスーパーから出た。
メモに目を落とし、リストを確認する。
dialogues.en:
I walk out of the store with a big grocery bag in my hand. I
look at the list again and check that I've got everything.
dialogues.text:
I walk out of the store with a big grocery bag in my hand. I
look at the list again and check that I've got everything.

dialogues.jp: 「買い逃しも……ないな」
dialogues.en: "I got everything......"
dialogues.text: "I got everything......"

dialogues.jp:
ちょっとした主夫の気分を味わいつつ、商店街
の出口に向かう。
dialogues.en:
Feeling like a husband, I keep walking to the end of the
street.
dialogues.text:
Feeling like a husband, I keep walking to the end of the
street.

dialogues.jp:
行き過ぎる人の中には、やはり主婦らしき人の
姿が多い。袋から長ネギがはみ出てるのは……
もしかして、デフォルト？
dialogues.en:
There are many women who look like wives on this street. Why
does everybody have a long onion sticking out of their bag?
Is there a rule of how to put groceries in a bag??
dialogues.text:
There are many women who look like wives on this street. Why
does everybody have a long onion sticking out of their bag?
Is there a rule of how to put groceries in a bag??

dialogues.jp:
「けど、頼子さんて何で、外に出たがらないん
　だろうな……？」
dialogues.en: "But why doesn't Yoriko-san want to go outside......?"
dialogues.text: "But why doesn't Yoriko-san want to go outside......?"

dialogues.jp:
杉並が言ったように外が嫌いではあるんだろう。
問題は、｛・・／何故｝嫌いなのかってところにある。
dialogues.en:
Like Suginami told me, I guess she hates to go outside. But
the question is why?
dialogues.text:
Like Suginami told me, I guess she hates to go outside. But
the question is why?

dialogues.jp: 「何故……か」

デリケートな問題を含んでいるようで、｛き／訊｝いて
いいものやら悩むところではある。
dialogues.en:
It seems to be a delicate question and I don't know if I
should ask her or not.
dialogues.text:
It seems to be a delicate question and I don't know if I
should ask her or not.

dialogues.jp: 「その昔、ドラ猫に引っ｛か／掻｝かれたとか……」
dialogues.en:
"Maybe once upon a time a street cat scratched her
face......"
dialogues.text:
"Maybe once upon a time a street cat scratched her
face......"

dialogues.jp: そういう｛ほほえ／微笑｝ましい理由ならいいのだが。
dialogues.en: I hope her reason is something cute like that.
dialogues.text: I hope her reason is something cute like that.

dialogues.jp:
そろそろ商店街を出るというところで、それに
気が付いた。
dialogues.en: I'm almost to the end of the street when I notice it.
dialogues.text: I'm almost to the end of the street when I notice it.

dialogues.jp:
羊の群の中に、場違いな狼が紛れ込んでいるよ
うに、それは俺の目に飛び込んできた。
dialogues.en: I find it like finding a wolf in a bunch of sheep.
dialogues.text: I find it like finding a wolf in a bunch of sheep.

dialogues.jp:
電柱。そこに白いチラシが張り付けられている。
例の、あれ。
dialogues.en: There's a light pole with a white flyer stapled on it.
dialogues.text: There's a light pole with a white flyer stapled on it.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、その前に立った。
dialogues.en: I stand in front of it.
dialogues.text: I stand in front of it.

dialogues.jp: 「猫を探してます……か」
dialogues.en: "I am looking for my cat......"
dialogues.text: "I am looking for my cat......"

dialogues.jp:
昨日の自分の台詞が思い出される。“飼い主は
ワラをも｛つか／掴｝む気持ちで──”
dialogues.en:
I remember what I told Suginami yesterday. The owner must be
so desperate......
dialogues.text:
I remember what I told Suginami yesterday. The owner must be
so desperate......

dialogues.jp:
商店街の人達は、電柱には目もくれず、通り過
ぎていく。
dialogues.en: People keep passing by without even taking a look at it.
dialogues.text: People keep passing by without even taking a look at it.

dialogues.jp: 「杉並を恨むぜ、ほんと」
dialogues.en: "It's Suginami's fault."
dialogues.text: "It's Suginami's fault."

dialogues.jp:
俺もあんな風に、素知らぬ顔で歩けたら良かっ
たのに。
dialogues.en: I wish I could walk away like the others.
dialogues.text: I wish I could walk away like the others.

dialogues.jp: 「……でも、彼女は猫じゃない」
dialogues.en: "......But she's not a cat."
dialogues.text: "......But she's not a cat."

dialogues.jp:
自分に言い聞かせるように呟き、俺はその場を
去った。
dialogues.en: I tell myself, walking away.
dialogues.text: I tell myself, walking away.

dialogues.jp:
チラシに記載された連絡先には、どうしても
目を向けられなかった──。
dialogues.en: I couldn't look at the contact information on the flyer...
dialogues.text: I couldn't look at the contact information on the flyer...

dialogues.jp: ◆『猫を探しています』◆
dialogues.en: ◆Junichi◆
dialogues.text: ◆Junichi◆

dialogues.jp:
料理を作ってみたいと言う頼子さんに頼まれ、
俺は買い物に出かけることになった。
dialogues.en: Patter-patter-patter...
dialogues.text: Patter-patter-patter...

dialogues.jp: 彼女は相変わらず外には出たがらない。
dialogues.en: "Ah... H-Hi...... Junichi-san......"
dialogues.text: "Ah... H-Hi...... Junichi-san......"

dialogues.jp:
買い物を終え、帰宅しようとした時、電柱に貼っ
てあったチラシが目に入った。
dialogues.en: "Hi, Yoriko-san."
dialogues.text: "Hi, Yoriko-san."

dialogues.jp: 『猫を探しています』
いつか杉並に見せられたものと同じものだ。

彼女は猫じゃない、そう思っていても俺は、そ
の連絡先にはどうしても目を向けられなかった。
dialogues.en:
As I'm about to take off my shoes, I notice she's staring at
me.
dialogues.text:
As I'm about to take off my shoes, I notice she's staring at
me.
